versions.changelog:
- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- No changes to logic or functionality; documentation and process remain the same.

- Added new scripts: resolve_eval_target.py (for parsing save targets), and chat_context.py (for group chat context and bindings).
- Updated skill logic: save target is now determined by resolve_eval_target.py with clarified private/group chat rules.
- In group chats, saves are now team-only and rely on group bindings; personal knowledge base is no longer allowed for group sessions.
- Removed outdated skill-card.md file.
- Added a section listing all helper scripts and their purposes.

Version 3.0.0 — Major update: Adds automated GitHub repository evaluation flow.

- Now fetches repo metadata, README, and dependencies for evidence-based assessments.
- Evaluates repositories based on usefulness, reproducibility, relevance, and activity.
- Generates clear evaluations (worth exploring / selectively reference / not recommended) with relatedness to research area.
- Automatically saves evaluation results to the appropriate personal or team knowledge base.
- Only activates for user requests fitting specific evaluation intents.

- Initial release of the eval-repo skill for evaluating and archiving GitHub repositories within the paper-kb system.
- Automatically evaluates a GitHub repo based on README, dependencies, metadata, and the user’s research direction, providing a relevance score and structured report.
- Stores the evaluation as a "project" entry in the user’s Gitea knowledge base, generating and updating related concept/resource pages when appropriate.
- Integrated logic for deduplication, knowledge base enrichment, and LeetCode sync (if configured).
- Replies to users in Feishu with a concise, actionable assessment and knowledge base link.
